subscriptions.err_period_void.en: The document for this period, {ref}, is void. To bill the period again, use Reopen on its row in the periods list, then Generate due.

subscriptions.due_already.en: Already billed before this run, so not billed again: {n}.

subscriptions.err_early_due.en: A period is already due (bill date {date}). Use Generate due to bill it. Bill early only bills a period whose bill date has not come yet.

subscriptions.err_not_moved.en: {ref} is not on a schedule yet, so it cannot bill: {reason}. Correct its schedule on this page and it moves onto one at once.

subscriptions.not_moved_pending.en: it moves onto a schedule the next time Celerp starts

subscriptions.notice_schedule_not_moved_.en: Some subscription templates are not on a schedule
These templates could not be moved onto a schedule and do not bill until you correct their schedule on their page: {templates}.

subscriptions.notice_back_periods_title.en: Some subscriptions have more than one period to bill

subscriptions.notice_back_periods_body.en: The earlier release billed one overdue run at a time. This release bills each missed period separately, so these templates have more than one period due (count in brackets): {templates}. Skip any period you do not want to bill.

subscriptions.skip_reason_paused_before_.en: Missed while paused before the upgrade

subscriptions.resume_restarts_note.en: This was paused before the upgrade. Resume restarts it from today, as the earlier release did: the periods missed while paused are skipped, and each can be un-skipped.

email.err_no_transport.en: No email service is set up. Connect Web Access, or set up SMTP in the server settings, then retry.

email.err_relay_refused.en: Web Access refused this email. Check the connection in Web Access, then retry.

email.err_smtp_unreachable.en: Celerp could not connect to the SMTP server. Check the SMTP settings, then retry.

email.err_smtp_login.en: The SMTP server refused the sign-in. Check the SMTP user name and password, then retry.

email.err_smtp_refused.en: The SMTP server refused this email. Check the sender and recipient addresses, then retry.

subscriptions.err_send_unverified.en: The last attempt to send this email may have arrived. Check with the customer before sending it again.

subscriptions.err_request_key_reused.en: This request was already used for a different billing action. Reload the page and try again.

subscriptions.err_send_preparation.en: The email could not be prepared. Check the document, then retry.

subscriptions.summary_send_pending.en: {ref} is billed and its email has not been sent yet.

subscriptions.timing_advance.en: In advance, at the start of each period

subscriptions.timing_arrears.en: In arrears, after each period ends

subscriptions.stop_at_period_end.en: Stop at the end of the current period

subscriptions.done_already_billed.en: {ref} already bills {start} to {end}, so nothing new was billed.

subscriptions.done_paused.en: Agreement paused. Nothing bills until you resume it.

subscriptions.done_unskipped.en: {start} to {end} is open to bill again.

subscriptions.done_reopened.en: Reopened {start} to {end}. It can be billed again.

subscriptions.err_skip_reason.en: Enter a reason for skipping this period.

subscriptions.err_stop_draft.en: A draft has no current period yet. Activate it first, or set an end of term.
